Overview

Kalisz is a city in Greater Poland with a population of 99,106. One of Poland’s oldest cities, dating back over 2,000 years, known for its historic old town, textile industry, and the nearby Prosna River. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
